questions.question: How many calls does a Facebook lead get before it's dead-leaded?
questions.explanation: Facebook leads get 1 call, then are dead-leaded (the automatic email still goes). All other leads get 3 calls.

questions.question: How many calls do other leads (not from Facebook) get?
options: Until they answer
questions.explanation: All leads other than Facebook leads get 3 calls.

questions.question: When can you offer the deposit route?
options: As soon as the price comes up
Whenever they ask how to pay
Only once they've made it clear they can't pay in full
Never
questions.explanation: Pay in full is rule 4. Get as much paid upfront as possible, and never offer the deposit route until they've made it clear they can't pay in full.

questions.question: How do you transfer a caller to admin?
options: Always a warm transfer, never cold
A cold transfer, so admin can pick up when they're free
Don't transfer: give them the admin email
questions.explanation: Since 20 Aug 2026, transfers to admin are always warm, never cold.

questions.question: A learner asks you for a refund on the phone. What do you do?
options: Promise it if they're within 14 days
Process it yourself
Never promise a refund: they email in, and admin confirms or declines it
questions.explanation: Never promise a refund on the phone. The learner emails in, and admin confirms or declines it.

questions.question: When should you offer a discount?
options: Only if you need to, to make the sale
On every call, to close faster
Only to learners who have bought before
questions.explanation: Rule 5: only offer a discount if you need to, to make the sale.

questions.question: A learner says they've already spoken to someone else, but can't say who. Whose sale is it?
options: Whoever has been on shift longest
Split evenly across the team
Yours
questions.explanation: Ask for the name. If they can name them, pass it over. If not, it's your sale.

questions.question: You think someone has broken the fair play rules. What do you do?
options: Raise it with them in the office
Slack Shannon discreetly
Post it in the team channel
questions.explanation: Handle it professionally, assuming an innocent mistake. Slack Shannon discreetly, and don't talk about it openly in the office.
